golden_baseline_location: $OTTERWORKS_LEGACY_ROOT/parsed/CUSTBILL_DEMO_001.psv (sha256 7fc03e8ceb88ce807b18e3e0a8bb2450b7677108495bdcb883881887c09665bf) and CUSTBILL_DEMO_002.psv (sha256 b576ad3de53b835643dc9096781cb491e6a03b3712c675c5598ab05f8c3c54a3), 50 rows each, from a real run of `make legacy-etl-run JOB=parse_custbill_fixedwidth`; malformed-record coverage is graded against the 2019-2024 history manifest at $OTTERWORKS_LEGACY_ROOT/sftp-drop/history/expected/demo-history-expected.json (sha256 d230027ae2eab43194f455e2b8f4822105b298019649732060f29f266662c653)

acceptance_checks.description: Layout fidelity: copybook CBCUST01 positions are parsed as declared (1-10 cust id, 11-40 name, 41-48 date, 49-60 amount with implied 2 decimals, 61-63 currency, 64-65 record type). HDR/TRL records are excluded from the record set.
Typed columns: amount is DECIMAL (cents-exact, never float), date is DATE, record type resolves to INVOICE (01) / CREDIT (02), currency is a 3-char code. No string surgery on dates or amounts.
Row parity against the golden .psv for the clean seed: 100 rows for ns=demo, every silver row matching a .psv row on all six fields, with zero rows quarantined for that input.

Trailer reconciliation is enforced, not logged: a file whose TRL count disagrees with its body count fails the file and quarantines its records with reason trailer_count_mismatch. This is the deficiency ETL-0187 asked for in 2011.

Declared expectations are stored as data (ow_tp.ops.parse_expectations_<ns>), not buried in code: layout width, date validity, currency whitelist, record-type domain, amount numeric. Each quarantined row carries the expectation id it violated and the raw source line.

Malformed-record coverage against the history feed: every record the manifest declares malformed is quarantined with the matching reason class, and no record the manifest declares valid is quarantined. Set equality both ways, not counts only.
Idempotency: re-parsing the same input replaces rather than appends; row counts, quarantine counts and amount totals are unchanged, proven with Delta history before/after.
No orphaned temp state (the legacy parser leaves /tmp/cb_body.$$ behind on failure) and no blanket error suppression: a parse failure fails the run with the file and record offset named.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: single-byte fixed-width, decoded at silver only
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: bronze bytes are the input of record; parsing never rewrites the landed object. Trailing pad spaces are trimmed from text fields (matching legacy behaviour for id, name and currency) and that trim is declared, not incidental.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: a record containing bytes that are not decodable in the declared encoding is quarantined with reason undecodable_bytes and its raw bytes retained hex-encoded — the legacy parser would have passed it through mangled

malformed_record_policy.details: Fixed-width input has no delimiters, so 'extra fields' means a record longer than the declared layout and a short record means one shorter: both are quarantined (reason record_length_mismatch) rather than sliced by cut into silently wrong values. A field that is blank or unparseable in a declared-NOT-NULL position quarantines the record with the offending field named (reason classes invalid_date, non_numeric_amount, unknown_currency, unknown_record_type) — never NULL-filled into silver, and never attributed to the previous record.

empty_input_semantics.details: A period or file with no records writes zero silver rows for that file and records a parse_runs entry with records=0, trailer=0 — a successful empty parse. A period with no file at all is absent from parse_runs entirely, so 'nothing arrived' and 'an empty file arrived' are distinguishable in recon rather than both reading as zero.

planted_anomalies.description: Records whose BILL-DATE is not a valid calendar date (the legacy parser reformats them to YYYY-MM-DD with no validity check).
Records whose BILL-AMT contains non-numeric bytes, which the legacy awk coerces to 0.00 and passes into finance totals.
Files whose TRL trailer count disagrees with the number of body records.
Records shorter or longer than the declared 65-byte layout.
A currency outside the declared whitelist or a record type outside {01,02} — the legacy report renders the latter as UNKNOWN(<rt>) and keeps its amount in the totals.
Duplicate customer id within a single drop file.
planted_anomalies.reason: The feed has no declared uniqueness rule per file (a customer can legitimately appear on an invoice and a credit in the same drop), so duplicate ids are not a defect class and must not be quarantined; deduplication policy belongs to the gold rollup unit.
